Because the karst measurement is bound to the dawn signature, the oasis audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 229 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
